app.name: Jagra
app.tagline: Tests Android builds before they go to QA.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitleBefore: One project per app. Its flows and settings live in the
projects.removeNote: Remove from list is on each project's page, and never deletes any file.
projects.runsBlocked: Runs cannot start until this is fixed.

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.text: Start with the sample app. It has one bug planted on purpose, so the first run shows what a failing flow looks like. You need an emulator or a phone that is ready.
empty.create: Create a project from an app folder

secrets.description: Values for variables such as ${PASSWORD} in flows, stored encrypted in the system's credential store for each project.
secrets.none: No flow of this project uses a variable.
secrets.unused: No flow uses it any more
secrets.note: The list comes from the variables the project's flows use. Values never show on screen, in logs or in reports.

language.title: Language
language.label: Language
language.note: It changes at once, without restarting Jagra. Flow files and logs stay in English.

tools.description: For tools installed in an unusual folder. A location set here is used first.

editor.system: The system's default app for .yaml files
editor.hintWindows: For example Code.exe of Visual Studio Code. Jagra adds the file path at the end.
editor.hintMac: For example Visual Studio Code.app. Jagra opens the file with it.

env.title: Environment check
env.subtitle: Jagra uses the tools already installed on this computer. It never installs, updates or removes anything.
env.failed: The check could not finish. Press Check again.
env.untestedNote: An untested version can still be used. If something does not work, report the version with About > Copy info for bug report.
env.continueAfter: You can continue once {{tool}} is ready

problem.needs-java: It cannot start without Java 17 or newer, so fix Java first.
problem.timed-out: It did not answer in time.
problem.failed: It was found but did not run.
problem.too-old: Version {{version}} is older than Jagra supports.
problem.untested-version: This version is newer than the ones Jagra was tested with, and can still be used.

adb.name: adb
adb.title: Android platform tools (adb)
adb.why: Jagra uses adb to install the APK and talk to the device.

maestro.name: Maestro
maestro.title: Maestro
maestro.why: Maestro runs every flow, so a run cannot start yet.

emulator.name: Android emulator
emulator.title: Android emulator
emulator.note: Not needed when tests use a phone over USB
emulator.why: Without it, tests run on a phone over USB.

mockoon.name: Mockoon CLI
mockoon.title: Mockoon CLI
mockoon.note: Only for projects that use a Mockoon file
mockoon.why: Projects that use a Mockoon file cannot run without it.

java.install-jdk-17-or-newer: Install a JDK, version 17 or newer, for example Eclipse Temurin.
java.set-java-home: Set JAVA_HOME to the JDK folder, or add the JDK's bin folder to PATH.

adb.install-android-studio: Install Android Studio, which includes the Android SDK and adb.
adb.set-android-home: Set ANDROID_HOME to the Android SDK folder, or add its platform-tools folder to PATH.

emulator.install-from-sdk-manager: In Android Studio, open SDK Manager and install Android Emulator.
emulator.create-virtual-device: Create a virtual device in Device Manager.

maestro.install-java-first: Make sure Java 17 or newer is ready first. Maestro needs it.

windows.download-zip: Download maestro.zip from the Maestro releases page on GitHub.
windows.extract: Extract it to a folder that stays where it is, for example:
windows.add-to-path: Add this folder to PATH in the Windows Environment Variables window:

macos.run-install-script: Run Maestro's install script in Terminal:

maestro.check-again: Come back here and press Check again. Jagra does not need to restart.

create.title: Create project
create.subtitle: Choose the Android app's code folder. An empty folder works too, for testing with an APK only.
create.newJagra: There is no .jagra folder yet. Jagra will create:
create.nothingElse: No other file in this folder changes.
create.existing: The .jagra folder already exists and is read as it is. Flows: {{flows}}. Helper flows: {{helpers}}.
create.existingWithMockoon: The .jagra folder already exists and is read as it is. Flows: {{flows}}. Helper flows: {{helpers}}. It uses a Mockoon file.
create.teamHint: A teammate's project only needs a device, then Run.
create.brokenConfig: The project is added as it is, and Jagra changes nothing in it. Once config.yaml is fixed, the project opens as usual.
create.name: Project name
create.nameHintAfter: , so the whole team sees the same name.
create.newBuildsUsed: New builds from Android Studio are used right away.
create.noApk: There is no APK in that folder yet. Build the app in Android Studio first, or choose an APK file below.
create.apkBuilt: built {{ago}}. Its version could not be read.
create.mockoonTipUrl: The debug build must call the API at http://localhost on the Mockoon port.
create.mockoonTipHttp: The debug build must allow plain HTTP to localhost through Android's network security config.

flows.title: Flows
flows.noneBefore: No flows yet. Flows are YAML files in
flows.leftOut: It is left out of runs.

run.title: Run
run.toolsBlocked: Fix these tools before a run:

device.noAdb: adb was not found, so devices cannot be listed.
device.none: There is no emulator or phone yet.
device.noneHelp: Create an emulator in Android Studio (Device Manager), or connect a phone with USB debugging on. This list updates on its own.
device.starting: This emulator is still starting. The run waits until it is ready.
device.offStarts: An emulator that is off is started first.
device.notAuthorised: This phone has not allowed USB debugging.
device.notResponding: This phone does not respond. Unplug it and plug it in again.

checklist.usb-debugging: Turn on USB debugging in Developer options.
checklist.accept-prompt: Unlock the phone and accept the USB debugging prompt.
checklist.screen-on-unlocked: Keep the screen on and unlocked during the run.
checklist.simulated-input: On Xiaomi phones, also turn on "USB debugging (Security settings)" in Developer options.

running.deviceBooting: Waiting for Android to finish starting
running.emulatorNote: A newly started emulator takes time, usually under a minute and at most 3 minutes.
running.oldAndroid: Android {{version}} on this device is older than Maestro supports, so flows may fail.
running.footer: Every flow starts from clean app data. Results are saved as soon as each flow ends.

uninstall.title: The app on the device was signed with another key
uninstall.text: {{packageName}} on {{device}} comes from another build, so this APK cannot be installed over it. Jagra can uninstall that app, then install this APK.
uninstall.warning: The app's data on this device is deleted too.

results.interruptedNote: Jagra closed while the run was going.
results.notFound: This run is no longer saved.

secrets.title: Fill in the variable values
secrets.text: The chosen flows use these variables, and they have no value yet.
secrets.hint: Stored encrypted in the system's credential store for this project, and never shown on screen, in logs or in reports.
secrets.failed: The value could not be stored, because the system's credential store is not available.

package.title: Different APK package
package.text: This APK is {{packageName}}, while appId in .jagra/config.yaml is {{appId}}. The flows may open another app.

steps.launchAppClean: Open the app with clean data

flowDetail.crashNote: The app crashed while the flow ran. The crash report from the device is below.
flowDetail.anrNote: The app stopped responding while the flow ran. The report from the device is below.
flowDetail.changed: This flow file changed after the run, so its steps may not match the marks.
flowDetail.missing: This flow file is no longer in the project, so its steps cannot be shown.
flowDetail.screenshotAlt: Screenshot from Maestro at the failing step
flowDetail.noScreenshot: Maestro saved no screenshot for this flow.
flowDetail.black: This screenshot is black. The app probably uses FLAG_SECURE, which blocks screenshots.
flowDetail.blackFix: Turn FLAG_SECURE off in debug builds only, so the screen at a failure can be seen.
flowDetail.notFound: This flow is no longer saved in this run.

history.title: Run history
history.subtitle: The last 20 runs are kept. Older ones are deleted with their files.
history.emptyText: Every run is kept here, including runs that were cancelled or interrupted.

about.creator: Rifan Setiadi
about.bugInfoNote: It copies Jagra's version, the operating system, each tool's version and the latest part of the log, with secrets masked.

errors.PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND: {{program}} was not found. Install it, or set its location in Settings > Tool locations.
errors.PROGRAM_IS_SCRIPT: {{program}} at {{path}} is a script, which Jagra does not start. Install the program itself.
errors.CONFIG_NOT_A_MAP: {{file}} must be a list of fields, such as "format: 1".
errors.CONFIG_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: {{file}} uses format {{found}}, and this Jagra reads format {{supported}}. Update Jagra.
errors.SECRETS_MISSING: These variables have no value: {{names}}. Add them in Settings > Secrets.
errors.NO_FLOWS: There is no flow to run. Add a flow first.
errors.RUN_SAVE_FAILED: The run could not be saved in {{folder}}.
errors.APK_NOT_FOUND: No APK was found in {{searchPath}}. Build the app, or choose an APK.
errors.APK_UNREADABLE: {{file}} could not be read as an APK.
errors.OUTPUT_MASK_FAILED: Maestro's output could not be checked for secrets, so it was not kept.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_AUTHORISED: Phone {{deviceId}} has not allowed USB debugging. Unlock it and accept the prompt.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_RESPONDING: Phone {{deviceId}} does not respond. Unplug it and plug it in again.
errors.EMULATOR_NOT_READY: Emulator {{name}} was not ready after {{minutes}} minutes.
errors.ADB_TIMED_OUT: adb {{command}} did not answer in time.
errors.INSTALL_FAILED: The APK could not be installed.
errors.PACKAGE_NAME_INVALID: "{{packageName}}" is not a package name. Check appId.
errors.INSTALL_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH: {{packageName}} on the device was signed with another key and was kept.
errors.MOCKOON_PORT_MISSING: {{file}} has no port. Set mockoon.port in .jagra/config.yaml.
errors.MOCKOON_PORT_BUSY: Port {{port}} is already in use. The Mockoon desktop app may be open with the same port: stop that mock, or close the app.
errors.MOCKOON_NOT_READY: Mockoon did not answer on port {{port}} within {{seconds}} seconds.
errors.FLOW_HEADER_MISSING: {{file}} has no header. Start it with "appId:" and "---".
errors.FLOW_HEADER_NOT_A_MAP: {{file}}, line {{line}}: the header must be a list of fields.
errors.FLOW_APP_ID_MISSING: {{file}}, line {{line}}: the header has no appId.
errors.FLOW_PROPERTIES_INVALID: {{file}}, line {{line}}: "properties" must be a list of fields.
errors.FLOW_STEP_INVALID: {{file}}, line {{line}}, is not a Maestro step.
errors.FLOW_AI_COMMAND: {{file}}, line {{line}}, uses {{command}}, which lets an AI decide the result. Jagra does not run it.
errors.FLOW_HELPER_NOT_FOUND: {{file}}, line {{line}}, calls {{helper}}, which does not exist.
errors.PROJECT_SETUP_FAILED: The .jagra folder in {{folder}} could not be created.
errors.MOCKOON_FILE_OUTSIDE_PROJECT: {{file}} is outside the project folder. Choose a Mockoon file inside it.
errors.SAMPLE_NOT_BUNDLED: This build of Jagra has no sample app.
errors.SAMPLE_COPY_FAILED: The sample app could not be copied to {{folder}}.
